title: KAITO — Happy Anniversary! 2025〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Where should I put these, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Wow, look at those huge musical note balloons!
Let's see...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Okay, let's get those right there by the main table!
I want everyone to feel really excited when they take their seats!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Roger♪
se_walk_women_004_1

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: MEIKO, the main dish is just about done, so could I get you to handle the plating?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Sure thing.
Is the sauce on this table what you want to finish it off with?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yeah, that's it!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Alright, the food's all coming along great!
That just leaves the dessert...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Today, I have permission to use anything in the fridge... What should I make?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Oh yeah, shouldn't the others be showing up to help prepare soon? Then...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Looks like KAITO's having fun.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. He surprised me when he came by saying he wanted to help prepare...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well, it is like him to want to enjoy everything right from the preparations.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hahaha, I totally know the feeling.
You want to have all the fun you can!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, everyone!
We're here to help prepare for the party... Wait...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Over in the kitchen... Is that KAITO?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
If KAITO is already here, then...
Could it be that we mistook the time of the party?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
No, you're all right on time.
KAITO just got here too early.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait... Even then, what's this guy doing setting up for his own party...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's the obvious reaction, right?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We were gonna make sure the decor and the food was all super awesome and totally surprise KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But then he shows up way before he's supposed to and was all “I'll help too!”... Now he's doing pretty much everything by himself!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ahh... Gotcha...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, welcome everybody!
Nice timing!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nice timing?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yeah. I figured you'd be here soon, so I brewed coffee.
Go ahead and have some if you like!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait... Coffee?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We appreciate that very much, but we should really help out with the party...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
It's fine, it's fine!
We've got the prep covered, so take a load off.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This is suspicious somehow...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Haha! There's no deeper meaning behind it, really.
It's just...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You're all working really hard during your practices to reach your goal, y'know? Even today, I hear you're meeting us after one of your practices.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It is cool how hard you guys work, but... I want you to relax a bit when you're here in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
So this is just my way of saying that.
That, plus thanks for coming to celebrate!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You were thinking of us that much...
Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, if that's the deal, then I'll happily have some.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Once we've had some coffee, then we'll definitely need to help with the prep!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay, now that we're all settled...
Happy anniversary, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy anniversary!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Thanks, guys!
Man, this just makes me so happy!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The party's just started, but I'm already having so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He really did do most of the prep on his own in the end...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. But it looks like he's enjoying himself, so I'm glad.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh yeah, people are doing anniversary stuff for the me in your world too, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes! Apparently they're doing a show for your anniversary.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A show?! I wanna see that!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Me too! I wonder what kind of event it'll be!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It's also being streamed, so we should be able to watch it.
Umm... Ah, here it is.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I hear you all loud and clear!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <This thought struck me again as I was up here singing... All of your voices really do give me strength.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Thanks for giving me so much!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Whoa, everybody in the audience is so pumped!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: There are so many comments coming in too.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha, it's kinda weird to see a version of me getting wished a happy anniversary in your world. Still...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Being able to get all pumped up with so many other people... It just shows how great shows are.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then why don't we put on a special anniversary event for you right now?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, good plan! That sounds so fun!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm in too! C'mon, let's do it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Celebrating with a song or two sounds like us!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, and we still haven't thanked him for brewing us coffee either. Let's give this our all.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, I think I'll join in as the DJ!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, you're gonna be in it?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yeah! It'd feel like such a waste to just sit and watch when such a fun event is happening... And besides, I wanna have fun with you guys!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm gonna get this event more heated up than anyone! Think you can keep up?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sheesh... Does this guy remember it's his anniversary?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: To think he'd take part in everything from the party prep to his own anniversary event...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
But he looks like he's having a lot of fun, so I guess there's no problem.
This party feels very KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Alright!
The equipment's all set!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Now then... Let my special anniversary event begin!
